name: fulfillment
description: Three subnets, and one transition that is BOTH fused and guarded. An event link fuses placing an order with reserving stock, so those two entities fire atomically. A guard link then gates that same fused step on a THIRD entity's marking — credit must be cleared — which no member fires. The coordinator therefore has to assemble a marking for an entity it only reads, decide, and fence that sibling in the same atomic append as the two member events.
